description: The first-run setup window. It may walk a machine from virgin to ready - probe, run the setup chain, install tmux and agent CLIs, pick a server binary, read the tmux docs, and open the dashboard or the console - and nothing else: no service verbs, no bare init (setup is the chain), no logs, no config-path reveals, no tray settings. Pinned equal to what wizard.ts actually invokes by ui/src/__tests__/ipc-acl.test.ts; the console keeps the full set because the console is the repair surface.
